name: Imouto Ijikuri Gakushuu Nikki
original_name: 妹いじくり学習にっき
source:
My parents went on vacation, leaving me and little sister allllll aloneeee. 

Of course we won't do anything forbidden? 
Nah, we'll definitely do it.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE076186]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我父母去度假了，留下我和妹妹独自一人。

我们当然不会做任何被禁止的事情吗？
不，我们一定会做到的。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE076186]DLsite英文[/url]]
